name: AdaLN-Zero
tagline: Class embedding produces scale/shift/gate parameters that adaptively modulate features after each ResBlock; time embedding unchanged.
diff_from_baseline: Peebles & Xie 2023 (DiT). Adaptive LayerNorm with zero-initialized gate; class conditioning never touches the time embedding.

name: Concat-FiLM
tagline: Add the projected class embedding to the timestep embedding so conditioning enters the UNet via FiLM-style adaptive GroupNorm.
diff_from_baseline: Standard label-into-time conditioning used in ADM / improved-DDPM. Simplest design: ClassConditioner is a no-op, all class info rides on the time embedding.

name: Cross-Attention
tagline: Class embedding serves as key/value in cross-attention layers inserted after each ResBlock; time embedding unchanged.
diff_from_baseline: Rombach et al. 2022 (Stable Diffusion). Standard text/label-as-context cross-attention conditioning.
